qualitative_boundaries: Genetic in PROCEED means authors aimed to account for heritable component via common garden or quantitative genetic methods, not proof of adaptive fitness, selection, or speciation.
Plant phenotypic change rates measured within ≤500 years cannot by themselves establish a response to LGM or climatic adaptation.
Source location at present-day or recently observed samples is not necessarily an ancestral glacial locality.
Reciprocal transplant fitness or a documented selection test remains necessary to call change adaptive rather than simply heritable.
Do not rerun closed TTF genetic response tests or open PROCEED rate/trait values during source-only census.
